title: 第16章 误会第17章 刺探
slug: 诡秘星轨交织的夜第222章
content_zh:
“啊？”克莱恩不解伦纳德话中之意，但见到伦纳德，意味着队长也回来了，便顾不上与奥莉安娜太太寒暄，“队长回来了吗？我有事找他。”
伦纳德以为这位幸运的占卜家又有新发现，边套话边带克莱恩去邓恩的办公室。
奥莉安娜见人走了，默默回到原位，继续工作。
“你遇到了一位白发蓝眼的野生非凡者？她还可能对你有威胁？”伦纳德忍笑再次确认。
克莱恩一心只想汇报，丝毫未察觉伦纳德的异样，即便察觉，他整天笑嘻嘻的，有什么奇怪的？
“是的，她是否与我们调查的事有关？我觉得还是向队长报告为好。”
“嗯，你说得对。”她确实对你有些威胁，因为她现在想抓你。
此刻唯一了解真相的伦纳德心中暗想。
伦纳德敲门时，邓恩已静静听完莫甘娜和克莱恩的事。
早在莫甘娜提及莫雷蒂先生时，邓恩便大致掌握了情况，想着克莱恩会来汇报，就没有揭破一切，静待事态发展。
莫甘娜刚说完自己的猜测，门外便响起敲门声，转头便与跟在伦纳德身后的克莱恩对视。
瞬间，莫甘娜和克莱恩都明白了！
原来是自家人不识自家人？
不对呀！廷根值夜者小队何时有了这个人？
这是莫甘娜和克莱恩共同的疑问。
即便当事人都知是误会，看热闹不嫌事大的伦纳德却未停手。
像个乖孩子一样，举手，给克莱恩一个表现的机会，“队长，克莱恩发现了一位非官方非凡者，要向你报告。”
莫甘娜和克莱恩同时低下头。
“咳咳，都是误会。”大家长邓恩开口解释，“正式介绍一下。莫甘娜，这位是克莱恩·莫雷蒂，我们值夜者小队的新成员，序列九的占卜家，最近才加入我们。”他转向克莱恩，“克莱恩，这位是莫甘娜，也是值夜者的一员，刚来廷根，是我的疏忽，没告诉你们。”
“……”

办公室陷入一片寂静。
伦纳德终于忍不住，“噗嗤”一笑，赶紧捂嘴，但肩膀仍忍不住耸动。
邓恩扫视眼前两位恨不得立刻消失的队员，无奈摇头，嘴角却勾起一丝微不可察的笑意。
“挺好的，你们的……嗯，防范意识都很强。”他幽默地评价，打破了尴尬的沉默。
“好吧……”克莱恩找回声音，看向莫甘娜和队长，“这就是场误会，也挺好，瞧，我们的认识方式多特别，别人还得羡慕呢。”
莫甘娜也松了口气，脸上恢复冷静，耳根却泛起一丝红晕，“很高兴认识你，莫雷蒂先生。”
“很高兴认识你，维斯珀小姐。”
误会解除，两人一同离开办公室，伦纳德仍笑着跟在后面。
“你早就知道了！”克莱恩这才明白伦纳德的异常，他恐怕早就知是误会，就等自己出丑。
“不只我，队长也知道，只是选择当面解决而已。”伦纳德笑着耸肩，“况且，罗珊见过维斯珀小姐，她应该跟你提过，有位白发小姐找过队长，克莱恩，你没想到，怎能怪我？”
克莱恩一时语塞，回想罗珊确实提过，但因急切未将两人联系。
现在好了，经过这件事，白发这一特征已深深印在他脑中，想忘都忘不掉了。
content_en:
"Ah?" Klein didn't understand the meaning of Leonard's words, but seeing Leonard meant that the captain was back, so he didn't bother to chat with Mrs. Orianna, "Is the captain back? I have something to see him for."
Leonard thought that the lucky fortune teller had made a new discovery, so he took Klein to Dunn's office while making excuses.
When Orianna saw someone leaving, she silently returned to her original position and continued working.
"You met a wild Beyonder with white hair and blue eyes? She might also be a threat to you?" Leonard confirmed again while holding back a smile.
Klein only wanted to report and didn't notice anything strange about Leonard. Even if he did, he was smiling all day long. Is there anything strange about it?
"Yes, is she related to what we are investigating? I think it is best to report to the captain."
"Well, you're right." She is indeed a bit threatening to you because she wants to catch you now.
Leonard, the only one who knew the truth at this moment, thought to himself.
When Leonard knocked on the door, Dunn had quietly listened to Morgana and Klein's story.
As early as when Morgana mentioned Mr. Moretti, Dunn had a rough grasp of the situation. Thinking that Klein would report, he did not reveal everything and waited for the development of the situation.
As soon as Morgana finished telling her guess, there was a knock on the door, and she turned to look at Klein who was following Leonard.
In an instant, Morgana and Klein both understood!
It turns out that my family doesn’t recognize my family?
That’s not right! When did the Tingen Nighthawks team have this person?
This is a question shared by Morgana and Klein.
Even though the parties involved knew it was a misunderstanding, Leonard, who was not too concerned about the fuss, did not stop.
Like a good boy, he raised his hand and gave Klein a chance to show off, "Captain, Klein has discovered an unofficial Beyonder and wants to report to you."
Morgana and Klein lowered their heads at the same time.
"Ahem, it's all a misunderstanding." Headmaster Dunn explained, "Let me introduce you formally. Morgana, this is Klein Moretti, a new member of our Nighthawks team, a fortune teller from Sequence Nine, who has only recently joined us." He turned to Klein, "Klain, this is Morgana, and is also a member of the Nighthawks. I just came to Tingen. It was my negligence and I didn't tell you."
"..."
The office fell into silence.
Leonard finally couldn't help it, laughed "Puff", and quickly covered his mouth, but he still couldn't help but shrug his shoulders.
Dunn glanced at the two team members in front of him who wished they could disappear immediately. He shook his head helplessly, but a subtle smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
"It's good. You guys are... well, defensive." He commented humorously, breaking the awkward silence.
"Okay..." Klein found his voice and looked at Morgana and the captain, "This is just a misunderstanding, and it's good. Look, the way we know each other is so special that others must envy it."
Morgana also breathed a sigh of relief, her face regained her composure, but there was a hint of blush in her ears, "Nice to meet you, Mr. Moretti."
"Nice to meet you, Miss Vesper."
The misunderstanding was resolved, and the two left the office together, Leonard still following behind with a smile.
"You already knew this!" Only then did Klein understand what was wrong with Leonard. He might have known it was a misunderstanding and was just waiting for him to make a fool of himself.
"Not only me, but the captain also knows, but he just chose to deal with it face to face." Leonard smiled and shrugged, "Besides, Roxanne has met Miss Vesper. She should have mentioned to you that a white-haired lady came to see the captain. Klein, you didn't expect it, so how can you blame me?"
Klein was speechless for a moment, recalling that Roxanne had indeed mentioned it, but did not contact the two of them out of urgency.
It's fine now. After this incident, the feature of white hair has been deeply imprinted in his mind, and he can't forget it even if he wants to.
